human_facing_rationale.summary: The after runtime capture opens the GPS map as a wider city/world-map overlay rather than a cramped corner panel. Current location, quest marker, known neighborhood places, and locked frontier destinations are more separated and easier to scan.
human_facing_rationale.child_facing_readability: improved: a child can identify the current marker, quest destination, and locked frontier labels faster because the map has more spacing and larger route geography.
human_facing_rationale.visual_hierarchy: improved: the expanded map has a clearer viewport, larger route span, and less label crowding while leaving the core play scene visible.
human_facing_rationale.canon_alignment: improved: the map better communicates that Act 1 sits inside a larger Arizona city with Salt River and Copper Mine frontier destinations beyond the neighborhood.
human_facing_rationale.runtime_truth: verified from live Playwright screenshot artifacts captured before and after the change.
human_facing_rationale.before_after_improvement: improved: the after screenshot is visibly wider and easier to parse than the before screenshot.
